worldOverview.readme:
# Stress test

## The setup screens are the new part

Rolls now happen when you press **Enter World**, not when the story starts. So every screen below should read real names — never a braced list of options, never raw token text.

### 1. Pins that rename other things — tick these and watch

| Trait | Pins | Watch it change |
|---|---|---|
| **Redhead** | HairColor → `red` | its own description, and the Keeper's image tags |
| **Sedge Native** | Town → `Sedge` | the trait *below* it, both location names, the **stat name**, and a dictionary trigger |
| **Marrow Native** | Town → `Marrow` | same targets, opposite value — they are an exclusive pair, so only one can hold |
| **Winter Child** | Season → `Winter` | the trait-group heading and the system prompt preview |
| **Ironblood** | Metal → `Iron` | the Warden's name, and the *Unique* chips on the two strays — a pin is per-placeholder, so it must flatten both |

Untick any of them and the **rolled** value must come back. A pin masks; it never overwrites.

### 2. Competing pins — later trait wins

**Sedge Native** and **Marrow Native** are an exclusive group, so they cannot both hold. **Tarnished** and **Ironblood** are *not* exclusive and both pin Metal — tick both and the one later in authored order must win, consistently, on every surface at once.

### 3. Pin edge cases

- **Sigil Bearer** pins a **Variable** (one value). The pin must still beat it.
- **Offworlder** pins Town to `Ashfall` — a value **not in the placeholder's list**. Authoring lets you; it should just apply.
- **Nihilist** pins the empty-valued placeholder to `something`, so a name that resolved to nothing now resolves to something.
- **Hollow** pins a **deleted** placeholder. Should be inert, not a crash.
- **Bonded** is on by default and pins HairColor — so the very first render of the picker must already show the pinned value, never a rolled one that flips a frame later.

### 4. Re-roll / stickiness

Season has 8 values and Metal has 6. Note them on the trait screen, then:

- **Back** through the steps — values must not move.
- **Abort** out and re-enter — they *should* re-roll (that is the design).
- Reach the game — the stat panel and story text must show the **same** values the pickers did.
- Save, exit, load — the save's values must come back, not fresh ones.

### 5. In play

The four **player-toggleable** traits (Redhead, Ironblood, Tarnished, Winter Child) can be switched in the Traits tab mid-game. Every pinned name should follow live — stat bars included, since stat deltas are matched by resolved name.

### 6. Editor

Names hold chips as coloured pills showing values; inside a field being edited the chip shows the placeholder **name**. `Ghost Alias` and the `Hollow` trait point at a deleted placeholder — red `?`. Drag from the strip at the top of the panel, or type `{`.

stats.name: {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0003}} Standing
stats.description: Stat NAME holds a chip. Tick a Native trait and this bar must rename itself.

stats.name: {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:world:place-0004}} Temper
stats.description: A second pinned stat name, so two pins can be seen disagreeing independently.

traitGroups.name: {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0005}} Origins
traitGroups.playerDescription: Exclusive: at most one. Both members pin Town, to opposite values.

traitGroups.name: Marks of {{ph:ph-seas-0000-0000-0000-000000000006:world:place-0006}}
traitGroups.playerDescription: A GROUP name holding a chip — pinning Season must rename this heading.

traitGroups.name: {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:world:place-0007}} Blood
traitGroups.playerDescription: A nested group whose name holds a chip. Two members both pin Metal, non-exclusively.

traitGroups.name: Edge Cases
traitGroups.playerDescription: Pins that are legal but strange. None of these should crash anything.

traits.name: Native of {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0008}}
traits.playerDescription: You grew up in {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0009}}. Ticking this must rename the trait below, both locations, and a stat.
traits.aiDescription: The player is a native of Sedge.

traits.name: Sworn to {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0010}}
traits.aiDescription: The player is sworn to Marrow.

traits.name: Bonded
traits.playerDescription: A default-on pin. Hair reads {{ph:ph-hair-0000-0000-0000-000000000004:world:place-0013}} before you touch anything.

traits.name: Child of {{ph:ph-seas-0000-0000-0000-000000000006:world:place-0014}}
traits.playerDescription: Born in {{ph:ph-seas-0000-0000-0000-000000000006:world:place-0015}}. Pins the season that names this trait AND its group heading.
traits.aiDescription: The player was born in winter.

traits.name: {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:world:place-0016}} Tarnished
traits.playerDescription: Pins Metal to Copper. Tick this AND Ironblood — the later one must win everywhere at once.

traits.name: Ironblood
traits.playerDescription: Pins Metal to Iron. Also flattens the two strays' **Unique** chips, since a pin is per-placeholder.
traits.aiDescription: The player has iron in the blood.

traits.name: Bearer of the {{ph:ph-sigil-000-0000-0000-000000000008:world:place-0017}}
traits.playerDescription: Pins a Variable (one value). {{ph:ph-sigil-000-0000-0000-000000000008:world:place-0018}} must read Owl, not Hawk.
traits.aiDescription: The player bears the owl sigil.

traits.name: Offworlder
traits.playerDescription: Pins Town to a value that is not in its list. {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0019}} should read Ashfall anyway.

traits.name: The {{ph:ph-empty-000-0000-0000-000000000005:world:place-0020}} Truth
traits.playerDescription: Pins the empty placeholder, so a name that resolved to nothing now resolves to "Void".

traits.name: Hollow {{ph:ph-deleted-00-0000-0000-000000000099:world:place-ghost-21}}
traits.playerDescription: Pins a placeholder that no longer exists, and its own name holds one. Inert, not fatal.

traits.name: Half-Written
traits.playerDescription: Carries two incomplete pin rows. {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0022}} must still read its rolled value.

traits.name: Unremarkable
traits.playerDescription: No chips, no pins — the control.

locations.name: {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0023}} Square
locations.playerDescription: The market square, quiet in {{ph:ph-seas-0000-0000-0000-000000000006:world:place-0024}}. Tick a Native trait and this name must change with the other one.
locations.aiDescription: A busy market square at the centre of town.

locations.name: {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0028}} Docks
locations.playerDescription: Wet boards and rope. The second starting location, so the picker step appears.

locations.name: {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:world:place-0030}} Row
locations.playerDescription: Reached by a connection whose name a trait can rename mid-game. It must stay reachable.

entities.name: Keeper {{ph:ph-keep-0000-0000-0000-000000000002:world:place-0032}}
entities.playerDescription: She runs the inn on {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0036}} Square, and has since {{ph:ph-seas-0000-0000-0000-000000000006:world:place-0037}}.
entities.aiDescription: A calm innkeeper who knows everyone.

entities.name: {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:world:place-0039}} Warden of {{ph:ph-town-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:world:place-0040}}
entities.playerDescription: Two World chips in one name — both pinnable, independently.

entities.name: Stray {{ph:ph-beast-000-0000-0000-000000000003:unique:place-0043}}
entities.playerDescription: Unique mode: rolls its own value. Its collar is {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:unique:place-0045}}.
entities.aiDescription: A wary animal near the docks.

entities.name: Second {{ph:ph-beast-000-0000-0000-000000000003:unique:place-0046}}
entities.playerDescription: A different Unique roll of the same wildcard. Its collar is {{ph:ph-metal-000-0000-0000-000000000007:unique:place-0048}} — pin Metal and BOTH collars must flatten.

entities.name: {{ph:ph-empty-000-0000-0000-000000000005:world:place-0049}}
entities.playerDescription: Its name resolves to nothing until the Nihilist trait pins the empty placeholder.

entries.value: The forge on the row works the metal the town is known for.
